photos.desc: Two sweet sweet Snow Buntings were still at Long Branch State Park today. Yay! What beauties! More photos to come. :)
Snow buntings (Plectrophenax nivalis) are tiny but tough songbirds that nest in Alaska. They are some of the first birds of spring to arrive in the high Arctic and have special adaptations to survive
A white and black songbird looks for insects along the ground. Credit: Lisa Hupp/USFWS
